title: DeployActionPlan
description: Executable snapshot of an approved deployment plan, carried by the `deploy_plan_apply` action kind (PRP-08 item 12). The API derives it from the approved plan; its resource list is written into the ActionIntent proposed_diff (`add /resources/<service>` operations next to `test /plan_hash` and `test /resources_digest`), so the maker confirms and the approver decides on the exact set of resources. plan_hash is the SHA-256 of the canonical plan the approver approved; the executor refuses an apply whose plan is not approved or whose hash differs. Uninstall (`deploy_uninstall`) is dry-run only and carries no resource list. Contains no credential, secret or principal e-mail.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this document (semver within major 1).

plan_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest with algorithm prefix of the approved plan.

deployment_id.description: Deployment the plan belongs to (ownership register key).

cloud.description: Azure cloud of the deployment. Never routed to the other cloud.

resources.description: Resources to create or reuse, in apply order.

resource_spec.description: One resource the apply creates or reuses. Reused resources are only recorded in the ownership register, never modified.

service.description: Manifest service key, lowercase snake_case (for example `analytics_workspace`).

kind.description: Provisioning path: Fabric capacity (ARM), Fabric workspace (Fabric REST) or another ARM resource.

resource_id.description: ARM resource id of the resource being reused; null when it is created.

consent_reference.description: Owner consent reference; required for a reused resource, null otherwise.
